notes.title: Unforeseen Consequences
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30406835/9ae7644144445c259945d79640c4b02a1acc6b63.png[/img]

[h1]Well, this wasn't supposed to happen..[/h1]

While preparing for the beta and putting the finishing touches on the release, we ran into some critical infrastructure issues that have become a real thorn in our side (and unfortunately, cannot be fixed in our normal timespan.) The problems we've encountered are part of systems that are crucial to the beta, as well as the game in general. Due to these problems that caught us off-guard, we're publicly announcing that we have to delay the beta until further notice.

[h1]What if I've been waiting to play?[/h1]
Well, we've got a little bit of good news: Starting as of today, we'll be randomly selecting a small group of players who have registered for the beta (As well as active members of our community) to become closed alpha testers to help us refine the product and fine-tune the issues we've run into so that we can launch later down the line with a smoother, wider-scoped beta than originally planned which will allow us to hit more problems on the head and deliver a better experience for everyone

Thanks again, and sorry for the inconvenience. You guys rock for keeping patient!
Corrupted Pixel Staff

notes.title: CLOSED BETA DATE ANNOUNCED
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30406835/1e6581a689f906442ade646160da498cb9d6c031.png[/img]

[h1]Hey, enthusiasts![/h1]
We have some exciting news for you! The closed beta will go live [b]FEBRUARY 6th[/b]. We will start sending out invites starting [b]FEBRUARY 1st[/b]. 

[h1]Can I still register?[/h1]
Yeah, you can still register [url=https://waysidesolutions.com/]here[/url]

[h1]What can I expect from the beta?[/h1]
The CBT will contain two gamemodes, Elimination and Team Elimination, with four maps. We are planning on releasing more content as the beta goes on.

You can also [url=https://discord.gg/reboundarena]join our Discord Server[/url] to post feedback and suggestions and be in touch with the development of the game.

We hope to see you ingame.

notes.title: Official Discord
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30406835/0fddceeff34e270047fcdbdd3f840529be568430.png[/img]

[h1]Hey, enthusiasts![/h1]
We're back with a small update to promote our official Discord server!

[h1]Okay, why should I join the discord?[/h1]
By joining the Discord server, you will get involved with the Rebound community! Below you'll find the link to join our discord server, where you'll have direct access to moderators and developers that are part of the team at Corrupted Pixel. Ask questions, provide suggestions and feedback, and potentially be chosen for early access to the Rebound Beta!

[url=https://discord.gg/reboundarena]Join the Discord[/url]


Hope to see you in the discord ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: CLOSED BETA SIGNUPS
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30406835/bd673852858dee676e801c8fa85364a92f44e1fc.png[/img]

[h1]Hey, enthusiasts![/h1]
Bet you didn't expect that we'd be back with another post so soon, eh? We've got some good news: Signups for the closed testing build of Rebound Arena are now open! 

[h1]How do I register?[/h1]
You can register [url=https://waysidesolutions.com/]here[/url]

[h1]How do I know if I was accepted[/h1]
If accepted, you will receive an email with a key and activation instructions. Good luck, and thanks again for following Rebound Arena!

We hope to see you ingame.
